verses.original: אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַ֭יַּעַן
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·p̄az hat·tê·mā·nî way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Eliphaz the Temanite . . . replied

verses.original: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה ר֑וּחַ דַֽעַת־ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א בִּטְנֽוֹ׃ קָדִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: he·ḥā·ḵām ya·‘ă·neh rū·aḥ ḏa·‘aṯ- wî·mal·lê biṭ·nōw qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן בְּ֭דָבָר וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־ יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḵê·aḥ lō yis·kō·wn bə·ḏā·ḇār ū·mil·lîm lō- yō·w·‘îl bām
verses.literal: Should he argue with useless . . . words or speeches that serve no purpose

verses.original: אַף־ אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄- ’at·tāh tā·p̄êr yir·’āh wə·ṯiḡ·ra‘ śî·ḥāh lip̄·nê- ’êl
verses.literal: But you even undermine the fear [of God] and hinder meditation before Him

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֲוֺנְךָ֣ יְאַלֵּ֣ף פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ă·wō·nə·ḵā yə·’al·lêp̄ p̄î·ḵā wə·ṯiḇ·ḥar lə·šō·wn ‘ă·rū·mîm
verses.literal: For your iniquity instructs your mouth and you choose the language of the crafty

verses.original: פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־ אָ֑נִי יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־ בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: p̄î·ḵā wə·lō- ’ā·nî yar·šî·‘ă·ḵā ū·śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā ya·‘ă·nū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Your own mouth not mine condemns you your own lips testify against you

verses.original: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: hă·ri·yō·šō·wn ’ā·ḏām tiw·wā·lêḏ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tā wə·lip̄·nê ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Were you the first man ever born Were you brought forth before the hills

verses.original: תִּשְׁמָ֑ע הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ וְתִגְרַ֖ע חָכְמָֽה׃ אֵלֶ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: tiš·mā‘ haḇ·sō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·w·ha wə·ṯiḡ·ra‘ ḥāḵ·māh ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself

verses.original: מַה־ יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־ עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: mah- yā·ḏa‘·tā wə·lō nê·ḏā‘ tā·ḇîn wə·lō- ‘im·mā·nū hū
verses.literal: What do you know that we do not . . . What do you understand that is not clear to us . . .

verses.original: גַּם־ שָׂ֣ב גַּם־ יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר יָמִֽים׃ מֵאָבִ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: gam- śāḇ gam- yā·šîš bā·nū kab·bîr yā·mîm mê·’ā·ḇî·ḵā
verses.literal: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side men much older . . . than your father

verses.original: תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tan·ḥu·mō·wṯ ’êl ham·‘aṭ mim·mə·ḵā wə·ḏā·ḇār lā·’aṭ ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: Are the consolations of God not enough for you even words [spoken] gently to you

verses.original: מַה־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ וּֽמַה־ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃ יִּרְזְמ֥וּן
verses.transliteration: mah- lib·be·ḵā yiq·qā·ḥă·ḵā ū·mah- ‘ê·ne·ḵā yir·zə·mūn
verses.literal: Why has your heart carried you away and why do your eyes flash

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תָשִׁ֣יב רוּחֶ֑ךָ אֶל־ אֵ֣ל מִלִּֽין׃ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯā·šîḇ rū·ḥe·ḵā ’el- ’êl mil·lîn wə·hō·ṣê·ṯā mip·pî·ḵā
verses.literal: so that you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ יִזְכֶּ֑ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃ וְכִֽי־ יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ĕ·nō·wōš kî- yiz·keh yə·lūḏ ’iš·šāh wə·ḵî- yiṣ·daq
verses.literal: What is man that he should be pure or one born of woman that he should be righteous

verses.original: הֵ֣ן לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין בִּקְדֹשׁוֹ וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־ זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hên lō ya·’ă·mîn biq·ḏō·šō wə·šā·ma·yim lō- zak·kū ḇə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: If God puts no trust in His holy ones if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes

verses.original: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־ אִישׁ־ נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח שֹׁתֶ֖ה עַוְלָֽה׃ כַמַּ֣יִם
verses.transliteration: ’ap̄ kî- ’îš- niṯ·‘āḇ wə·ne·’ĕ·lāḥ šō·ṯeh ‘aw·lāh ḵam·ma·yim
verses.literal: how much less . . . man who is vile and corrupt who drinks injustice like water

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־ לִ֑י אֲחַוְךָ֥ וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃ וְזֶֽה־ חָ֝זִ֗יתִי
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘- lî ’ă·ḥaw·ḵā wa·’ă·sap·pê·rāh wə·zeh- ḥā·zî·ṯî
verses.literal: Listen to me and I will inform you I will describe what I have seen

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ יַגִּ֑ידוּ חֲכָמִ֥ים וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- yag·gî·ḏū ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·lō ḵi·ḥă·ḏū mê·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers

verses.original: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם הָאָ֑רֶץ נִתְּנָ֣ה וְלֹא־ זָ֣ר עָ֖בַר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·hem lə·ḇad·dām hā·’ā·reṣ nit·tə·nāh wə·lō- zār ‘ā·ḇar bə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them

verses.original: רָ֭שָׁע מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל כָּל־ ה֣וּא יְמֵ֣י וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ miṯ·ḥō·w·lêl kāl- hū yə·mê ū·mis·par šā·nîm niṣ·pə·nū le·‘ā·rîṣ
verses.literal: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days only a few years are reserved for the ruthless

verses.original: קוֹל־ פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl- pə·ḥā·ḏîm bə·’ā·zə·nāw baš·šā·lō·wm šō·w·ḏêḏ yə·ḇō·w·’en·nū
verses.literal: Sounds of terror fill his ears in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him

verses.original: לֹא־ יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ ה֣וּא וְצָפוּ אֱלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·’ă·mîn šûb̲ min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ hū wə·ṣå̄·p̄ū ’ĕ·lê- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: vvv He despairs of his return from darkness he is marked for the sword

verses.original: ה֣וּא נֹ֘דֵ֤ד לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע׀ כִּֽי־ נָכ֖וֹן יֽוֹם־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃ בְּיָד֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: hū nō·ḏêḏ lal·le·ḥem ’ay·yêh yā·ḏa‘ kî- nā·ḵō·wn yō·wm- ḥō·šeḵ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: He wanders about as food for vultures he knows . . . . . . the day of darkness is at hand

verses.original: צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ׀ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ṣar ū·mə·ṣū·qāh yə·ḇa·‘ă·ṯu·hū tiṯ·qə·p̄ê·hū kə·me·leḵ ‘ā·ṯîḏ lak·kî·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: Distress and anguish terrify him overwhelming him like a king poised to attack

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָטָ֣ה יָד֑וֹ אֶל־ אֵ֣ל יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃ וְאֶל־ שַׁ֝דַּ֗י
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ṭāh yā·ḏōw ’el- ’êl yiṯ·gab·bār wə·’e·lō·ša- šad·dai
verses.literal: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty

verses.original: יָר֣וּץ בְּצַוָּ֑אר אֵלָ֣יו בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yā·rūṣ bə·ṣaw·wār ’ê·lāw ba·‘ă·ḇî gab·bê mā·ḡin·nāw
verses.literal: rushing headlong at Him with a thick studded shield

verses.original: כִּֽי־ פָנָ֣יו כִסָּ֣ה בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ כָֽסֶל׃ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־
verses.transliteration: kî- p̄ā·nāw ḵis·sāh bə·ḥel·bōw ḵā·sel way·ya·‘aś pî·māh ‘ă·lê-
verses.literal: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh . . .

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן׀ נִכְחָד֗וֹת עָ֘רִ֤ים לֹא־ יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּ֭תִּים הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kō·wn niḵ·ḥā·ḏō·wṯ ‘ā·rîm lō- yê·šə·ḇū lā·mōw ’ă·šer bāt·tîm hiṯ·‘at·tə·ḏū lə·ḡal·lîm
verses.literal: he will dwell in ruined cities in abandoned . . . - houses destined to become rubble

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יֶ֭עְשַׁר חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹא־ יָק֣וּם מִנְלָֽם׃ וְלֹֽא־ יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ
verses.transliteration: lō- ye‘·šar ḥê·lōw wə·lō- yā·qūm min·lām wə·lō- yiṭ·ṭeh lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: He will no longer be rich his wealth will not endure His possessions will not overspread the land

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָס֨וּר׀ מִנִּי־ חֹ֗שֶׁךְ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃ וְ֝יָס֗וּר
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·sūr min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ šal·hā·ḇeṯ tə·yab·bêš yō·naq·tōw bə·rū·aḥ pîw wə·yā·sūr
verses.literal: He will not escape from the darkness the flame will wither his shoots and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away

verses.original: אַל־ נִתְעָ֑ה יַאֲמֵ֣ן בַּשּׁוֹ כִּי־ שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- niṯ·‘āh ya·’ă·mên baš·šō kî·šā- šā·wəʾ tih·yeh ṯə·mū·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness for emptiness will be his reward

verses.original: תִּמָּלֵ֑א בְּֽלֹא־ י֭וֹמוֹ וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: tim·mā·lê bə·lō- yō·w·mōw wə·ḵip·pā·ṯōw lō ra·‘ă·nā·nāh
verses.literal: It will be paid in full before his time and his branch will not flourish

verses.original: כַּגֶּ֣פֶן יַחְמֹ֣ס בִּסְר֑וֹ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kag·ge·p̄en yaḥ·mōs bis·rōw kaz·za·yiṯ wə·yaš·lêḵ niṣ·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי־ שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ‘ă·ḏaṯ ḥā·nêp̄ gal·mūḏ wə·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ā·ho·lê- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: For the company of the godless [will be] barren and fire will consume the tents of bribery

verses.original: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·rōh ‘ā·māl wə·yā·lōḏ ’ā·wen ū·ḇiṭ·nām tā·ḵîn mir·māh
verses.literal: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil their womb is pregnant with deceit
